fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) had 90% capacity in the September quarter occupied by data center customers, with most production capacity pre-secured through long-term supply contracts until 2028.
fields.summary_ko.1: Seagate's operating margin for fiscal Q1 2027 improved significantly to 48.9% from 26.9% YoY; Apple (AAPL) expects net margin to decline to 45~46% in the December quarter due to rising memory costs.
fields.summary_ko.2: Seagate trades at P/E of 26.3x (vs. Apple 38.7x), revenue growth of 44.4% (vs. Apple 15.1%), and operating margin of 40.5% (vs. Apple 33.0%), indicating it is more undervalued, growing faster, and more profitable.
